title: B-tree integrity reference bitmap and OOM stop state

scope.rationale: Integrity checking records fatal OOM exactly once and stops further reports, tracks page references in a compact byte bitmap, and uses the bitmap to reject invalid or duplicate references while consuming the source error budget.

external_source_responsibilities: Integrity-check allocator creates and frees the reference bitmap
dependencies.caller_closure: The OOM state transition, both bitmap helpers, and invalid/duplicate-reference owner are complete; integrity traversal consumes them in production.

inputs: Integrity-check owner and page number bounded by checked_pages
outputs: Reference-bit observation or mutation; sticky NoMemory stop state
contracts.ownership: Integrity owner owns the byte bitmap; helpers borrow and mutate it in place.
contracts.state_and_results: Bit i is byte i/8 mask 1<<(i&7). OOM stores NoMemory, zeros remaining error capacity, and increments errors only when no prior error exists.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No locks, callbacks, or I/O inside these helpers.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Bitmap bounds are asserted. OOM intentionally prevents further integrity messages.

representation_differences: Zig stores the result as optional bounded Error instead of an integer SQLite result code. The compact byte bitmap and page-to-bit arithmetic are exact.

oracle.protocol: Read an unset page bit, set it, read it again, detect a duplicate through checkReference, then transition a zero-error integrity owner to NoMemory stop state.
oracle.normalization: NoMemory maps to SQLITE_NOMEM; booleans normalize to zero/nonzero.

assurance.oom: Fatal integrity OOM state is represented and unit-traced; allocator-site injection remains pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Out-of-range pages are rejected by checkReference before bitmap helpers.
assurance.continuation: NoMemory zeros maximum_errors so message processing stops.
assurance.performance: Constant-time bit operations and state update.

integration.native_call_path: integrityCheck allocates the compact bitmap; checkTreePage/checkReference use the read/set helpers and duplicate detection.

independent_review.notes: Requires OOM injection/differential, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Inject integrity-message allocation OOM and compare stop state to pinned C.
